 export function createDraft(visitId: number): Prescription {
   return {
     id: nanoid(),

 }
+
+export function cloneDraft(draft: Prescription): Prescription {
+  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft))
+}
+
+export function duplicateForVisit(draft: Prescription, visitId: number): Prescription {
+  const copy = cloneDraft(draft)

+  copy.id = nanoid()
+  copy.visitId = visitId
+  copy.createdAt = new Date()
